title: Validate native context language position pairs
changes: Add EUR/Wine ordinary startup checks for direct generated reads of both context-language position tables across all five observed language choices.
validation: Wine arfmrs12 passes five raw/managed routes totaling 2120 frames; both bytes of both selected position pairs are read by generated APIs for every language, with altered backing sources and zero raw requests. Complete state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five nonempty audio streams match per frame.
Windows GNU test build tmmpkgkh passed; protected ROM, dataset, checkpoint, source and cache inputs remained unchanged. Wine drained and successful scratch was removed.
limitations: The wrapper establishes direct generated API requests, not exact guest load PCs. The result covers one startup route and language values 0–4, not other readers, writers, values, scenes, native Windows, Linux or USA.
